errors.LINK_IMPORT_OFF: Import from a link is switched off for this store.
errors.HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: This link cannot be read: only plain https links from the allowed sites. {fields}
errors.PAGE_UNREADABLE: The page could not be read.

linkImport.title: Import from a link
linkImport.intro: Paste a supplier's or brand's product page. You see what the page says, change what you like, and get a draft to finish. Nothing goes on the shop from here.
linkImport.off: Import from a link is switched off for this store (Settings › Catalogue).
linkImport.mock: The page reader is not switched on yet, so this shows a sample page made from the link — not the real page.
linkImport.mockLink: Switch it on in Keys & connections
linkImport.priceNote: Shown only. A price is never copied: you set prices yourself.
linkImport.skuNote: Shown only. The ERP code stays the product's key.
linkImport.sizesNote: Shown only. Sizes and SKUs come from the ERP.
linkImport.photosNote: {n} photo links on the page. Photos are not copied: upload your own.
linkImport.draftIntro: Check and change anything, then make the draft. It starts as a draft and is never put on the shop from here.

notes.ai-off: AI is switched off, so plain rules made this draft.
notes.ai-not-connected: AI is on but not connected yet, so plain rules made this draft.
notes.ai-not-used: AI is not used for imports (setting), so plain rules made this draft.
notes.ai-failed: AI did not answer, so plain rules made this draft.

linkImport.noWrite: Making a draft needs the right to change products.
linkImport.historyEmpty: No link has been read yet.

reasons.BAD_URL: That is not a plain web address.
reasons.BLOCKED_ADDRESS: This address is never read (it points inside a private network).
reasons.TOO_BIG: The page is larger than allowed.
reasons.TIMEOUT: The site did not answer in time. Try again.
reasons.TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: The link forwards too many times.
reasons.NOT_HTML: The link is not a web page (a photo or a file?).
reasons.HTTP_ERROR: The site answered with an error.
reasons.NETWORK: The site could not be reached.
reasons.NO_PRODUCT: No product was found on the page.

audit.title: Product audit
audit.intro: Every product that is not complete, with what it still misses. Each “Fix” opens the place to fix it.
audit.waiting: {n} more products will be checked the next time this page opens.

interest.title: Back in stock
interest.intro: A sold-out or hidden product keeps its page, and customers can ask to be told when it is back. This is who is waiting, per product.
interest.noContacts: Seeing phone numbers and e-mails needs the back-in-stock list permission.
interest.sendNote: Messages are sent by hand for now. Mark each person as told; automatic messages come with the message templates.
interest.empty: Nobody is waiting for a product.
